question: In the three Baruch crops just shown, can you distinguish (1) a patah under the first ו of ויהיו (2:5), (2) any vowel under ל in בקולך (3:4), and (3) the vowel under ש in עושכם (4:7)? Please report only what you can see in the print; “unclear” is useful.

decisions.decision: Retain patah on the initial vav; user confirmed the specific printed mark.
Replace provisional segol under lamed with the user-read sheva.
Replace provisional sheva under shin with the user-read tsere.

scope: Only the three shown occurrences. No generic pointing normalization.
